response.sql: WITH nationality_totals AS (SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, result_count, result_count - AVG(result_count * 1.0) OVER () AS count_vs_average FROM nationality_totals ORDER BY nationality;
